panels.title: Documentos procesados
panels.description: Documentos distintos que completaron al menos un stage en el rango.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT document_id)::int AS "Documentos"
FROM pipeline_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND status = 'completed'

panels.title: Ejecuciones fallidas
panels.description: Intentos con status='failed', reintentos incluidos. Rojo a partir de uno.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*)::int AS "Fallos"
FROM pipeline_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND status = 'failed'

panels.title: Coste de LLM
panels.description: Suma de cost_usd. Los modelos sin precio (Cloudflare) cuentan tokens pero no coste — el total es un piso, no un techo.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(sum(cost_usd), 0) AS "Coste"
FROM pipeline_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Reintentos
panels.description: Ejecuciones con attempt > 1. Cada una es trabajo repetido, y si llamó a un LLM, dinero gastado dos veces.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*)::int AS "Reintentos"
FROM pipeline_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND attempt > 1

panels.title: Duración por stage (p95)
panels.description: Percentil 95 de duration_ms por stage. Una sola medida: dónde se va el tiempo.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT stage AS "Stage",
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS "p95"
FROM pipeline_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND status = 'completed'
GROUP BY stage
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Latencia por stage en el tiempo (p95)
panels.description: Misma medida, por día. Sirve para ver si algo se degradó, no para comparar stages entre sí.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time,
       stage AS metric,
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS value
FROM pipeline_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND status = 'completed'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Coste por organización
panels.description: Suma de cost_usd agrupada por tenant. Esta es la pregunta que antes no se podía responder.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(organization_id, 'sin organización') AS "Organización",
       sum(cost_usd) AS "Coste"
FROM pipeline_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND cost_usd IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Coste diario de LLM
panels.description: Lo que vigila la alerta de gasto.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time,
       sum(cost_usd) AS value
FROM pipeline_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Últimas ejecuciones fallidas
panels.description: El trace_id enlaza con la traza en Tempo.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT created_at AS "Cuándo",
       stage AS "Stage",
       attempt AS "Intento",
       duration_ms AS "ms",
       left(error, 120) AS "Error",
       document_id AS "Documento",
       trace_id
FROM pipeline_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND status = 'failed'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 50
